verdict.rationale: Railway is a cloud deployment platform, so edge or serverless functions running full Node.js are a fair axis to judge it on. However, the evidence pack never mentions serverless or edge functions, a Node.js runtime, or npm package compatibility. Generic claims about deploying repos and running apps closer to users are about general app hosting, not this capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run unmodified Node.js code and npm packages in edge/serverless functions instead of a restricted runtime subset
